meta.title: Greenwood Apartments Odessa — Luxury Beachfront Apartments
meta.description: Greenwood Apartments — luxury first-line beachfront apartments in Odessa. Online booking and payment, pool, panoramic sea views, concierge service.

hero.title: Greenwood Apartments
hero.subtitle: Luxury apartments on the seafront — panoramic coastal views, a private pool and lush green grounds

about.title: A home on the seafront, surrounded by greenery
about.text: Greenwood Apartments is a modern premium complex on the first line of the sea, surrounded by a park. We created a space for those who value quiet, privacy and attention to detail — panoramic windows overlooking the coast, a private pool and lounge area, and a personal concierge who resolves any request within the day.

rooms.title: Choose your apartment
rooms.subtitle: Every room is individually designed — natural wood, linen textiles and panoramic sea-view windows

items.name: Studio Garden
items.description: A cozy studio overlooking the complex's green grounds, with a kitchenette and a terrace for morning coffee.

items.name: One Bedroom Deluxe
items.description: A spacious bedroom, separate living room and a fully equipped kitchen — perfect for extended stays.

items.name: Executive Suite
items.description: Apartment with a panoramic sea view, a spa bathroom and a dedicated workspace.

items.name: Greenwood Penthouse
items.description: A two-level top-floor penthouse with a private terrace and sea views — our flagship room.

items.title: 24/7 Concierge
items.description: Transfers, restaurants, tours — arranged any time of day

items.title: Private Parking
items.description: Secure parking in the residence's inner courtyard

items.title: High-Speed Wi-Fi

items.title: Breakfast in Room
items.description: Fresh pastries and local farm produce every morning

items.title: Outdoor Pool
items.description: Pool and sun-lounger lounge area on the grounds

items.title: Airport Transfer
items.description: We'll meet you and drive you in a comfortable car

items.title: Pet Friendly

items.name: Marina K.
items.text: The best apartments I've stayed in in Odessa. Sea view from the window and a pool downstairs — like a dream vacation.

items.name: Thomas R.
items.text: Immaculate design, right on the seafront and incredibly quiet. The concierge team went above and beyond.

items.name: Olena V.
items.text: The penthouse exceeded every expectation — the morning sea view is unforgettable. We'll definitely be back.

location.title: Right on the seafront
location.text: The complex sits on the first line of the sea on French Boulevard — one of Odessa's greenest and most prestigious seafront avenues, with a private pool and a lounge area by the water. The beach and the coast's best restaurants are all nearby.
